verdict: Uses real bl-notification and bl-notification-card tags with valid attributes (variant='success', caption='Saved', icon are all confirmed real API members), but the usage pattern is non-functional: bl-notification renders its cards from the notifications array added via the addNotification() JS API, not from slotted children, so the statically-nested bl-notification-card would not render as a toast. Dismissal is only the built-in card close button, never wired because the card never displays.
